acts.desc: A staffer at St Joseph Medical Center in Houston finds a patient shot on the floor of his room. He is unarmed, and has been shot by the cops in the hospital.
acts.label: Prologue
Act One
acts.desc: We tell the story of that patient, Alan Pean, and how his delusions lead him to a situation that's just as strange as the worst thoughts his mind is cooking up. This story is a collaboration with the New York Times.
acts.title: When Your Hospital-Borne Infection Is a Bullet

acts.label: Act Two
acts.desc: In this act, writer Michael Kinsley describes harnessing the power of his own mind to deal with his Parkinson's diagnosis. Michael Kinsley is a contributing columnist for Vanity Fair and the Washington Post. His articles on denial and living with Parkinson's are here and here.

songs.a: Beyoncé & “Where Is My Mind” by Vanilla Fudge

acts.title: Don’t Need to Know Basis
